answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the onyx. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
